purpose: y2s80-thumbcomp4: DIAGNOSTIC Nord2Metal = y2s79-thumbcomp3 with backboardd's logging made to fit its 256 KiB per-connection log budget (run tc3: BBFRAME/COMPOSITE/BBDRAW used it all up during boot; nothing was logged during Camera/Photos): BBFRAME/COMPOSITE off (on with /var/db/nord2-metal/bb-frame-probe), BBDRAW ARMED by the first composite that samples a >=1000x1000 surface that is not backboardd's own target (an application drawable), then logged on a change of the sampled set and 1 in 60, 90 composites max ('PHOTOS BBDRAW armed at composite ... by surface S').
